shortBulletSummary: Hotter-than-expected US inflation data (3.7% CPI) drove crypto sell-offs, increasing Fed rate hike odds.
Nearly $1 billion in crypto leveraged positions were liquidated as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slid.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $681 million in net outflows last week.
Persistent geopolitical uncertainty and conflicting signals are dampening overall risk appetite.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index stands at 34 ("Fear"), reflecting negative investor sentiment.
